caveats: This is source review, not runtime qualification; reviewer ran no tests, model calls, benchmark trials or container services.
Root owns final integration test execution and validation of the exact bytes in production_files.
Callback size reduction addresses repeated-history amplification, not a guarantee that all output from arbitrary-duration invocations fits the driver 8,000,000-byte whole-log cap.
Usage event ordinals are observations, not authenticated turn identifiers. Event values cannot be summed into a bill or substituted for the final-envelope contract.
No token savings, task success, proof discharge or applicability to largest-eigenval follows from these implementation changes.
Doctor fallback configuration validity remains enforced; a provider-incompatible ordinary-completion mode is still invalid before route execution.

checks.detail: Supported model representation controls no longer veto checked Doctor candidate routes. Closed mode and combination checks still execute, candidate_ready and zero provider calls remain required, candidate handoff argv remains separate, and existing materialization/source/independent-validation paths remain in force.

Requested controls remain in the report. not_applicable context/source observations require a matching materialization schema, task identity, commit for doctor_candidate, exact zero calls, false authority, successful cleanup, planning-only provider receipts, and no unreceipted attempt. Missing or contradictory evidence does not become zero usage or successful completion.

Current progress @2 requires closed nested usage observations with exact constants, first 128 rows, explicit omitted counts, closed counter names, integer bounds, finite observation times, strict event/frame ordinals and independent nested copies. Provider strings, identifiers, arguments, thoughts, source text and unknown fields are not exported.

Historical progress @1 is accepted with its exact historical field set and no fabricated usage history. Final native accounting continues to use the separate terminal-envelope projector; event rows do not establish usage completeness, additive totals, cache semantics, billing or authenticated turn identities.

Prior diagnostic finding resolved: after_final rows now require parent final-event time, non-earlier elapsed time, a monotone true suffix, and retained after-final count no greater than parent events_after_final. Existing parent validation joins final_event_seconds to final_envelope_observed. Observed usage event count cannot exceed frame count.

Transport callbacks and the router progress emitter both use grok_stream_progress_summary, which validates input, removes usage rows and returns closed count-only @1. Final result/receipt retain bounded @2 rows. Thus repeated five-second callbacks do not repeatedly serialize the full history into worker logs.
The new grok_stream_usage.py module is included in the current worker capability source inventory.

context_recommendation.conversation_limit: Existing compiler retry deltas do not control the native CLI internal conversation turns.
context_recommendation.existing_smallest_projection: An explicit worker_capsule_limit of one or two using prepare_semantic_context and existing semantic_capsule_selection can reduce selected advisory evidence while retaining the full index, source manifest, admission checks and explicit omissions.
context_recommendation.explanation: semantic_router_translation removes native semantic evidence rows before inserting translated_semantic. Source384 learned candidates and deterministic numerical summaries are different evidence and cannot be dropped as duplicates.
context_recommendation.priority_this_turn: Preserve provider-free Doctor completion and collect bounded numeric usage events before claiming a new context optimization.
context_recommendation.requirements_before_live: Bind the selection as an explicit benchmark treatment and measure complete authored real-router input bytes plus retrieval behavior before live use. Do not reclassify required formalization references as optional or claim a lossless reduction.

resolved_findings: after_final previously had only a Boolean type check and could contradict the parent final-event observation; explicit parent joins now reject those contradictions.
Repeated full event-history callbacks could amplify logs enough to exceed the benchmark collector whole-log cap; callbacks now carry validated count-only summaries.
